description: Per-agent and per-session budget caps with auto-throttle, hard stops, cost projections, and governance alerts. Goes far beyond Paperclip's flat monthly budgets — XRoads budgets are story-aware, time-aware, and tied to the orchestration layer.
goals: Per-slot and per-session budget caps with configurable thresholds
Auto-throttle at warning level, auto-pause at hard cap
Cost projection based on historical burn rate
Budget tied to PRD stories (cost-per-story estimation)
Visual budget dashboard with burn-down chart
non_goals: No billing integration — XRoads tracks costs, user pays providers directly
No multi-currency — everything in USD cents

BudgetConfig.description: Budget configuration for a session or slot

fields.slotId: UUID? FK AgentSlot — null means session-level budget
fields.warningThresholdPct: Int — percentage at which to warn (default 80)
fields.throttleEnabled: Bool — reduce request frequency at warning threshold

BudgetAlert.description: Alert generated when budget threshold crossed

fields.alertType: BudgetAlertType — warning, hard_stop, daily_exceeded, story_exceeded, projection_exceeded

user_stories.title: BudgetConfig + BudgetAlert DB migration
user_stories.description: Migration v10: budget_config table with session/slot FK, threshold fields. budget_alert table with config FK, alert metadata. Indexes on sessionId, slotId. CRUD repos for both. Default budget config created when session activates (configurable global default). Cascade delete with session.

user_stories.title: Cost monitoring daemon
user_stories.description: Background monitor that checks cost vs budget after every CostEvent. On each cost recording: 1) Calculate total spend for slot + session. 2) Compare against BudgetConfig thresholds. 3) At warning threshold: emit budget_warning event + create BudgetAlert + emit Tauri event for UI. 4) At hard stop: auto-pause the slot (transition to paused), create hard_stop alert, emit event. 5) Daily limit check: track daily aggregates, reset at midnight UTC. 6) Per-story limit: track cost since last story completion. Wire into existing record_usage command — cost check runs synchronously after insert.

user_stories.title: Cost projection engine
user_stories.description: Project future costs based on historical burn rate. Inputs: current spend, time elapsed, stories completed vs total. Projection methods: 1) Linear (spend/time * remaining time). 2) Story-based (avg cost/story * remaining stories). 3) Weighted (blend of linear + story-based). Output: projected total cost, projected time to budget exhaustion, projected cost at orchestration completion. Emit projection_exceeded alert if projected total > budget. Expose via Tauri command for UI consumption. Recalculate on every cost event.
tests: linear projection correct with sample data
story-based projection accounts for varying story costs
projection alert fires when over budget trajectory
projection updates on each cost event

user_stories.title: Throttle mechanism
user_stories.description: When warning threshold reached, reduce agent request frequency. Throttle modes: 1) Delay injection — add sleep between loop iterations (2x normal sleep). 2) Model downgrade suggestion — suggest switching from Opus to Sonnet (cheaper model, agent_lifecycle failover mechanism). 3) Story prioritization — pause low-priority stories, continue high-priority only. Throttle is reversible — if spend drops below threshold (e.g. projection recalculates lower), auto-resume normal mode. Throttle state tracked on AgentSlot (new field: throttleLevel 0/1/2/3).
tests: sleep delay doubles in throttle mode

user_stories.title: Budget dashboard UI
user_stories.description: Visual budget panel in cockpit: 1) Session-level budget bar (green/yellow/red fill). 2) Per-slot budget bars with agent icon. 3) Burn rate indicator ($/hour, $/story). 4) Projection line chart (actual spend vs projected vs budget cap). 5) Cost breakdown by provider/model (pie chart). 6) Alert history timeline. 7) Budget config editor (inline edit caps, thresholds). All real-time via cost-updated events. Compact mode for toolbar badge (just $ amount + color).

user_stories.title: Budget templates + presets
user_stories.description: Pre-configured budget presets: 1) Frugal ($5 session, $1/slot, Sonnet-only). 2) Standard ($25 session, $5/slot, mixed models). 3) Performance ($100 session, $20/slot, Opus allowed). 4) Unlimited (no caps, monitoring only). Budget preset selector in session activation dialog. Custom presets saved per-project in .crossroads/budget-presets.json. Preset includes: all BudgetConfig fields + recommended model strategy.
